learning_outcomes.text: To use the structure of Turkish language and punctuation properly.
To get the habit of reading books, follows the newspapers and magazines.
To speak Turkish in an appropriate way, has the ability to express themselves well.
To become capable of making presentations, to express his ideas and knowledge comprehensibly.
The student acquires oral and written communication skills.

syllabus_topics: Examining the writing stages and sample texts
Subject, theme, main idea, point of view, modes of narration
Examining types of written expression and examples of written expression
Fundamental practices in teaching writing: forms, résumés, formal petitions, and reports.
How do you write a scientific paper?
Preparing speeches for special occasions, diction, and its importance
bibliography: Ali Torun vd., Türk Dili ve Kompozisyon Bilgileri, Kütahya: DPÜ Yayını, 2010.
Ali Torun vd., Türk Dili ve Kompozisyon Bilgileri, Kütahya: DPÜ Yayını, 2010.
